scenario.title: Foglia River
intro.text:
FOGLIA RIVER - 2 SEP 1944

South of Foglia River , Italy

Welcome in Italy! The attack on the Gothic Line is under way! However, the German resistance is stronger than expected and parts of the British 8th Army must already be taken out of the front due to high losses and exhaustion. Your troops will replace these units. Perform a frontal assault against the German defense at the Foglia River and show our Allies friends to what Greeks are able!

GOAL Hold after the ninth turn 12 VH, 11 VH or 9 VH for BV, V or TV!

NOTE The unit occupying the town Morciano Di Romagna gets full replacements!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-14-0-briliant.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.reaction-14-0-briliant.text: The rebel-held nodes were secured before the mutiny could coordinate another response. Government authority has been restored—and thousands of Greek servicemen now wait behind guarded wire.
line.reaction-14-1-victory-tactical.text: The mutiny has been suppressed, but surrender, arrest, and political reprisal are already being written as the same event by different offices.
line.callback-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.callback-0.text: The harbour seizure now circulates through Allied staffs as a model operation. The report takes six pages. The prisoner compound appears in one sentence.
line.callback-1.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-1.text: Two men who surrendered through our Egyptian corridor have joined the brigade. They recognised me before I recognised them. I am relieved they were willing to speak.
line.scene-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.scene-0.text: The brigade formed from men the government trusted after April. The Canadians know that; the Germans do not care. I prefer the German examination.
line.scene-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.scene-1.text: Morciano keeps the coastal road open. Tavullia and Montecchio offer a turning movement, provided your engineers do not outrun every lorry assigned to them.
line.scene-2.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-2.text: The brigade has spent months being described as loyal. By tomorrow it may finally be described as useful.
line.decision.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.decision.text: Do we take our own line through the hills, or remain on the Canadian flank and make certain the guns and fuel arrive with us?
line.decision.choice.take-the-ridge-rout: Drive through Tavullia and Montecchio with the engineer companies.
Spend 50 prestige and give infantry 15 experience.
line.decision.choice.support-the-allied-: Secure Morciano and the coastal road in step with the Canadians.
Give artillery 10 experience and fully refuel and rearm the core.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-a-0.text: An independent thrust means independent trouble. If you lose the road, Canadian transport will not materialise because the Greek brigade has made a stirring advance.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.choice-a-1.text: Understood. Engineers lead through Tavullia; infantry follows before the demolitions settle. We take our own trouble and report our own position.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.choice-b-0.text: The men hoping for a spectacular return to combat will call this being kept on a leash.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-b-1.text: Let them. The coastal axis gives them artillery, transport, and a corps plan that knows where they are. Morciano first; then the road opens north.
